panels.title: GCP 本月累計
panels.description: 本月 1 日至今的 GCP 淨額；折線＝每天。BigQuery 帳單明細匯出（新台幣，已扣抵免）；資料晚幾小時到一兩天才齊，最近一天偏低。不含 Cloudflare、Modal。

targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP(DATE(usage_start_time, 'Asia/Taipei'), 'Asia/Taipei') AS time, SUM(cost) + SUM(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c), 0)) AS net FROM `gen-lang-client-0602998820.billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_018BA5_A4B827_5694C8` WHERE _PARTITIONTIME >= TIMESTAMP_SUB($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND $__timeFilter(usage_start_time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: GCP 月底預估
panels.description: 本月累計 ÷ 今天是本月第幾天 × 本月天數（最近一天帳單不齊，會略偏低）。BigQuery 帳單明細匯出（新台幣，已扣抵免）；資料晚幾小時到一兩天才齊，最近一天偏低。不含 Cloudflare、Modal。

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SUM(cost) + SUM(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c), 0))) / EXTRACT(DAY FROM CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Taipei')) * EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Taipei'))) AS forecast FROM `gen-lang-client-0602998820.billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_018BA5_A4B827_5694C8` WHERE _PARTITIONTIME >= TIMESTAMP_SUB($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND $__timeFilter(usage_start_time)

panels.title: D1 各資料庫用量
panels.description: 每個 D1 庫用了 10 GB 上限的幾成，最滿的在左；80% 起琥珀、90% 起紅（硬門檻）。成長速度與到門檻天數在 /v1/capacity。

targets.root_selector: ([$sort(rows, function($a, $b) { $a.utilization_pct < $b.utilization_pct }).{ 'db': ($n := $lookup({"DB":"主庫","CORE_DB":"核心","MARKET_DB":"行情","LEARNING_DB":"學習","OPS_DB":"營運","EXECUTION_DB":"執行","PAPER_DB":"模擬交易","RESEARCH_DB":"研究"}, binding_name); $n ? $n : '其他庫'), 'pct': utilization_pct }])

panels.title: Cloudflare 內含額度
panels.description: Workers Paid 方案每個帳單週期（依續約日，不是每月 1 日）內含的用量。請求、讀寫列＝照本期到目前的速度，到期末會用掉內含量的幾成；儲存＝最新一天的大小 ÷ 內含量。超過 100% 的部分照量計費（琥珀）。內含量：Workers 1,000 萬請求；D1 讀 250 億列、寫 5,000 萬列、存 5 GB；KV 讀 1,000 萬、寫 100 萬、存 1 GB。

url_options.data: {"query":"query($a: string!, $start: Time!, $until: Time!, $day: Date!) { viewer { accounts(filter: { accountTag: $a }) { w: workersInvocationsAdaptive(limit: 10000, filter: { datetime_geq: $start, datetime_lt: $until }) { sum { requests } } d: d1AnalyticsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: { datetimeHour_geq: $start, datetimeHour_lt: $until }) { sum { rowsRead rowsWritten } } ds: d1StorageAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: { date_geq: $day }, orderBy: [date_DESC]) { dimensions { date databaseId } max { databaseSizeBytes } } k: kvOperationsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: { datetime_geq: $start, datetime_lt: $until }) { dimensions { actionType } sum { requests } } ks: kvStorageAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: { date_geq: $day }, orderBy: [date_DESC]) { dimensions { date namespaceId } max { byteCount } } } } }","variables":{"a":"${cf_account}","start":"${cf_period_start}","until":"${__to:date:iso}","day":"${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}"}}

panels.title: Cloudflare 上期各項
panels.description: 上一個帳單週期各收費項目的金額，最多的在上，只列有收費的項目。D1 與 R2 儲存依累計 GB-月計費，超過內含量後每 1 GB-月收一次。各項分別四捨五入，加總可能與上期帳單差 US$0.01。來源：Cloudflare 帳單用量 API（美元，Cloudflare 以美元計費；GCP 面板是新台幣），資料到昨天。帳單週期從續約日起算（不是每月 1 日）。

panels.title: GCP 本月各服務
panels.description: 本月 1 日至今各服務的 GCP 淨額占比：前四大服務，其餘併成「其他」。BigQuery 帳單明細匯出（新台幣，已扣抵免）；資料晚幾小時到一兩天才齊，最近一天偏低。不含 Cloudflare、Modal。

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT service.description AS svc, SUM(cost) + SUM(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c), 0)) AS net FROM `gen-lang-client-0602998820.billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_018BA5_A4B827_5694C8` WHERE _PARTITIONTIME >= TIMESTAMP_SUB($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND $__timeFilter(usage_start_time) GROUP BY svc HAVING net > 0), r AS (SELECT IF(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net DESC) <= 4, svc, '其他') AS label, net, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net DESC) AS rk FROM s) SELECT label AS svc, SUM(net) AS net FROM r GROUP BY label ORDER BY MIN(rk)

panels.title: GCP 本月累計成本
panels.description: 實線＝本月每天的累計淨額，虛線＝照目前日均推到月底，琥珀虛線＝每月預算 NT$2,000（示範值）。BigQuery 帳單明細匯出（新台幣，已扣抵免）；資料晚幾小時到一兩天才齊，最近一天偏低。不含 Cloudflare、Modal。

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM DATE(usage_start_time, 'Asia/Taipei')) AS day, SUM(cost) + SUM(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c), 0)) AS net FROM `gen-lang-client-0602998820.billing_export.gcp_billing_export_resource_v1_018BA5_A4B827_5694C8` WHERE _PARTITIONTIME >= TIMESTAMP_SUB($__timeFrom(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND $__timeFilter(usage_start_time) GROUP BY day), c AS (SELECT day, SUM(net) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS actual FROM d), k AS (SELECT MAX(day) AS last, MAX(actual) AS mtd FROM c) SELECT g AS day, c.actual, IF(g >= k.last, k.mtd / k.last * g, NULL) AS forecast FROM k, UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Taipei'))))) AS g LEFT JOIN c ON c.day = g ORDER BY day
